title: The context-dependent duality of MEG3: a pivotal regulator and promising target in inflammation-associated diseases.
publicationName: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
journalName: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
snippet: Chronic inflammation, governed by epigenetic networks, underlies a broad spectrum of diseases. In this context, the long non-coding RNA maternally expressed gene 3 (MEG3) has emerged as a pivotal molecular node.
